summary: Delivery is under heavy pressure. Blockers dominate the risk profile (payment keys, third-party SLA, legal review, design system lock). Schedule slips and a single-person knowledge bottleneck compound the problem. Quality debt and late scope changes are secondary but growing.

risks.title: Payment gateway blocked for 20+ days — past due date
risks.evidence: Issue #42 labeled blocker + high-priority. Created 2026-07-10, due 2026-07-25 (missed). Waiting on production API keys from the provider.
risks.recommended_action: Escalate to the payment provider account manager today. Ship a sandbox/mock path so frontend and QA are unblocked.

risks.title: Third-party KYC vendor SLA breached — identity checks offline
risks.evidence: Issue #61 open 9 days. Vendor response time exceeded contracted 48h SLA. Signup funnel blocked for EU users.
risks.recommended_action: Invoke contractual escalation. Enable temporary manual KYC path for high-value signups.

risks.title: Legal review blocking public beta launch copy
risks.evidence: Issue #67 waiting on Legal for 11 days. Marketing pages cannot go live. No owner assigned on Legal side.
risks.recommended_action: Book a 30-minute review slot with Legal this week. Prepare a redline version in advance.

risks.title: Design system package unpublished — UI work stalled
risks.evidence: Issue #70: internal design-system npm package failed publish. Three feature PRs blocked on missing components.
risks.recommended_action: Hotfix the publish pipeline or pin a local tarball so feature work can continue.

risks.title: Database migration for new order schema still open past deadline
risks.evidence: Issue #29 labeled backend + high-priority + database. Created 2026-07-01, due 2026-07-20 (missed). Required before new order flow ships.
risks.recommended_action: Treat as release-blocking. Pair for knowledge transfer. Hard completion date within 5 business days.

risks.title: Mobile release window missed — app store review not started
risks.evidence: Issue #58 due 2026-07-22 (missed). Build is ready but App Store / Play submission checklist incomplete.
risks.recommended_action: Complete store assets today and submit. Communicate revised launch date to stakeholders.

risks.title: Sprint commitments at 140% capacity for two consecutive sprints
risks.evidence: Velocity board shows planned vs completed gap of 40%. Carry-over items growing each sprint.
risks.recommended_action: Cut lowest-priority items from next sprint. Protect buffer for blockers and support.

risks.title: Critical work concentrated on a single person (bus factor = 1)
risks.evidence: Alice is sole assignee on #29, #42, and #55. She owns PR #88. No secondary owner for the order schema.
risks.recommended_action: Pair Alice this sprint. Document schema and payment integration. Reassign at least one high-priority item.

risks.title: No backup for on-call during lead engineer PTO next week
risks.evidence: Issue #72: lead engineer PTO 2026-08-04–08. On-call rotation has empty slots. Production incidents would escalate to managers only.
risks.recommended_action: Assign a temporary primary on-call and run a 1-hour handoff walkthrough before PTO.

risks.title: New hire blocked waiting for production access (2 weeks)
risks.evidence: Issue #64: access request open 14 days. New engineer cannot run integration tests against staging.
risks.recommended_action: Escalate access ticket to IT security with a same-day SLA for new-hire onboarding.

risks.title: Flaky checkout tests open for 25 days
risks.evidence: Issue #38 created 2026-07-05, due 2026-07-15 (missed). 12 comments. Random CI failures slow merges.
risks.recommended_action: Quarantine flaky tests so they stop blocking PRs. Bug-bash or rewrite unstable assertions.

risks.title: Error rate on checkout API spiked 3× in last 48 hours
risks.evidence: Issue #75 opened from monitoring alert. 5xx rate on /checkout from 0.4% to 1.3%. No owner assigned yet.
risks.recommended_action: Page the backend on-call. Add a canary rollback plan and short-term rate limit if needed.

risks.title: New Black Friday discount engine added without estimate
risks.evidence: Issue #51 created 2026-07-27 with label unestimated, no assignee, no acceptance criteria. Marketing wants a full rules engine.
risks.recommended_action: Run a 30-minute estimation session this week. Decide: in-scope, deferred, or minimal viable version.

risks.title: Stakeholder requested multi-currency support mid-sprint
risks.evidence: Issue #69 opened 2026-07-28. No estimate. Touches pricing, tax, and invoice modules.
risks.recommended_action: Park behind a discovery spike. Do not pull into current sprint without explicit trade-offs.

risks.title: WIP payment PR open 12 days with little progress or status updates
risks.evidence: PR #88 opened 2026-07-18, last update 2026-07-28. Labeled wip. Linked to blocked payment workstream. No recent comment from author.
risks.recommended_action: Convert to draft with clear remaining tasks or close and re-open when unblocked. Post a short status on the related issue.

positive_signals: Most tickets have clear labels (blocker, high-priority, bug, feature)
Frontend work continues on non-blocked items
Monitoring caught the checkout error spike within hours
Demo data path ensures a useful report even on empty repos
trend_explanation: Blockers are the largest cluster (4 of 15). Schedule and people risks are compounding them. Without clearing the top blockers this week, release confidence will drop further.
next_steps: Escalate payment + KYC vendor blockers today
Reduce bus-factor on Alice — pair + document
Submit mobile builds and set a revised launch date
Quarantine flaky tests; investigate checkout 5xx spike
Estimate or defer Black Friday + multi-currency scope
